description: 臺中市寬頻管道引上點 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府建設局. 本資料內容為具有數值描述之寬頻管道引上點圖資(SHP)，範圍涵蓋本市中區、東區、西區、南區、北區、西屯區、南屯區、北屯區、豐原區、大里區、太平區、清水區、沙鹿區、大甲區、東勢區、梧棲區、烏日區、大肚區、大雅區、后里區、霧峰區、潭子區、龍井區、外埔區、大安區、新社區。 使用者應另行再下載，寬頻管道、寬頻管道引出管、寬頻管道手孔等三個檔案始為... Coverage: 臺中市政府建設局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府建設局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
